garusaṃvāsa:
2garu
mfn., m. and n. [S. guru; cf S. garīyas, gariṣṭha] (pl. nom. ~ū, ~uno), 1. (mfn.) (i) heavy, weighty; burdensome; difficult; Abh 840; Vin I 24,.21 (sace te … agaru vaseyyāma ekarattaṃ agyāgāre ti, na kho me mahāsamaṇa ~u); M I 266,.8 (mātā … gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharati mahatā saṃsayena ~uṃ bhāraṃ); S III 26,14* (nikkhipitvā ~uṃ bhāraṃ aññaṃ bhāraṃ anādiya); Ja I 196,1* (yato yato ~u dhuraṃ); II 338,.1 (sace hi imassa ~uṃ akatvā idān’ eva okāsaṃ karissāmi, Ce, Ee so; Be garukaṃ; Se gurukaṃ) ≠ 339,.18 (Be, Ce, Ee so; Se guruṃ); VI 234,26* (vāṇijānaṃ yathā nāvā appamāṇa-bharā ~u); Ud-a 229,.15 (~uṃ cīvaraṃ pārupanto kilamati); — (ii) heavy on the stomach, indigestible; Abh 840; Sadd 430,26* (dujjare … °-saddo pavattati); — 2. (i) (mfn.) important, serious; weighty, grave; Abh 840 (~u … mahante); Ja V 77,18* (nānumitto ~uṃ atthaṃ guyhaṃ vedetuṃ arahati); Mhv 18:18 (me … bhātuno vacanaṃ ~u); Vin-vn 2044 (dutiyātikkame ~u [āpatti]); — (ii) (n.) a serious offence; Vin-vn 393 (hoti thullaccayaṃ tesu paṭhame dutiye ~uṃ); Utt-vn 619 (pañca āpattiyo honti musāvādassa kāraṇā, pārājikaṃ ~uṃ thullaccayaṃ pācitti dukkataṃ); — see also garudhamma below, garuka; — 3. (i) (mfn.) highly prized; of great account; (to be) esteemed, venerated; M I 33,.10 (sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo c’ assaṃ manāpo ~u bhāvanīyo cā ti; Ps I 156,.32 : ~ū ti tesaṃ garuṭṭhāniyo pāsāṇacchattasadiso); A IV 154,.7 (ayaṃ pi dhammo piyattāya °-ttāya bhāvanāya … saṃvattati); Ja IV 371,10* (ācariyo brāhmaṇo mayhaṃ … ~u ca āmantaṇīyo ca); VI 14,14* (sakkatvā sakkato hoti ~u hoti sagāravo; 15,3´ : paresu ca sagāravo sayaṃ pi tesaṃ garuko hoti); Ap 320,.26 (durūpasaṅkamā buddhā ~ū honti); Mil 373,.22; Vism 536,.16 (yaṃ ārammaṇaṃ ~uṃ katvā cittacetasikā uppajjanti); Sp 234,.19 (satthusāsanaṃ ~uṃ katvā); Spk I 66,.10 (dosagarū ti dosaṃ ~uṃ katvā ādāya viharanto); III 221,.20 (buddhā nāma mahāpāsāṇacchattaṃ viya ~uno); — (ii) (m.) any venerated person (a parent, elder etc); esp. a (religious) preceptor, a teacher; an authority; Abh 840 (ācariyādimhi ~u mātupitusv api); D III 72,.10 (ācariyabhariyā ti vā ~ūnaṃ dārā ti vā; Sv 853,.38 : ~ūnaṃ dārā ti cullapitumahāpitu-ādīnaṃ bhariyā); M I 265,.18 (satthā no ~u satthagāravena ca mayaṃ vademā ti; Ps II 309,.15 : tattha ~ū ti bhāriko akāmā anuvattitabbo); A III 37,.23 (ye te bhattu ~uno bhavissanti mātā ti vā pitā ti vā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ti vā); Sn 325 (kālaññu c’ assa ~unaṃ dassanāya, Ce, Ee so; Be ~ūnaṃ; Se gurunaṃ); Th 588 (sussūsā ca ~ūnaṃ; Th-a II 252,.13 : ~ūnaṃ ācariyupajjhāyādīnaṃ kalyāṇamittānaṃ ovādassa sotukamyatā); Ja V 169,27* (bhavaṃ hi me aññataro ~ūnaṃ; 170,18´ : ~ūnan ti mātāpitunnaṃ me tvaṃ aññataro ti vatvā nisīdāpeti); Mil 91,.21 (~unā pi saha pavivittapavanaṃ pavisitvā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee gurunā); Vism 101,.6; Sp 1416,.12 (Buddhaghoso ti ~ūhi gahitanāmadheyyena therena); Ps I 10,.5 (bhagavā ti ~u, ~uṃ hi loke bhagavā ti vadanti, ayaṃ ca sabbaguṇavisiṭṭhatāya sabbasattānaṃ ~u); Mp II 305,.29 (ayaṃ samaṇo amhākaṃ ~u, imassa kathaṃ gahetuṃ yuttan ti); Ud-a 219,.27 (attani ~umhi ca ekatte pi bahu-vacanaṃ dissati); Sadd 430,.16 foll. (~ū ti mātāpitādayo gāravayuttapuggalā … api ca pāsāṇacchattaṃ viya bhāriyaṭṭhena ~ū ti vuccanti); 691,.23 (kattūnaṃ pañcavidhattaṃ api icchanti ~ū); 758,.19 (~ūnaṃ matantare …); — ifc (prizing, esteeming; respectful, obedient to) see appamāda- (sv pamāda), kodha-, dosa- (sv dosa2), dhamma- (sv dhamma1), vihāra-, satthu- (sv sattha[r]); — 4. (mfn.) (gr.t.t.) long, heavy (of a vowel/syllable in prosody); Sadd 607,.19 (dīgho ~u, ā ī ū bhū dhī mā); —      °’-ūpavāsa,   m. [garu + upavāsa1?], living with, associating with, one’s teacher(s), pupilship; Ps II 89,7* (~o uddeso uddiṭṭhaparipucchanaṃ …, Ce, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Se garusaṃvāso); —       °-karaṇa,   n. and mfn. [from garukaroti qv], 1. (n.) respect, venerating; Pj I 144,.15 (garukāro ~aṃ gāravatā); Th-a II 115,.30 (yassa puggalassa gāravo ~aṃ na vijjati); — 2. (mfn.) inducing respect; Vin V 92,.30 (ayaṃ pi dhammo sārāṇīyo piyakaraṇo ~o saṅgahāya … saṃvattati; Sp 1316,.22 : ~o ti taṃ puggalaṃ sa-brahmacārīnaṃ garuṃ karoti) = D III 245,.17 = A III 289,.22; —       °-kāra,   m. [from garukaroti qv], (an act of) respect, veneration; Vin IV 58,.14 (~-hetu); D III 203,.15 (na me so … amanusso labheyya … sakkāraṃ vā ~aṃ vā); Vv 5:10; Mil 386,.3 (sakkāre asakkāre ~e agarukāre, Be, Ce, Ee so; —       °-gabbhā,   (m) f (n)., pregnant; Abh 239; Ja III 231,.26 (tassā ca ~āya gabbho bhūmiyaṃ pati); Sp 1209,.22; Mp I 422,.11 (gharaṇī me ~ā); Dhp-a I 164,.12 (devī °-gabbhatāya … vegena gantuṃ nāsakkhi); —       °-garu,   mfn., very heavy; M I 332,.7 (kinnu kho me kucchi ~u viya, Ce, Ee so; Be ~o; Se °-garutaro; Ps II 416,.5 foll. : ~u viyā ti garugaruko viya thaddho pāsāṇa-puñjasadiso, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ~o viyā ti; cf Ps-ṭ [Be] II 320,.5 foll. : ukārassa hi okāraṃ katvā ayaṃ niddeso); —       °-gārava,   n., respectful veneration; Ja V 415,6´; Ap 30,.13; Sp 122,.18 (~-yutto so bhagavā); Spk I 86,.33; —       °-ṭṭhāniya,   °-ṭṭhānika,   mfn. and m., (one) taking the place of, having the status of, a venerated or esteemed person; D III 241,.4 (satthā dhammaṃ deseti aññataro vā ~o sabrahmacārī, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee garuṭṭhāniko); A III 393,.12 (satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā ~aṃ sabrahmacāriṃ); Ja V 265,13´ (pabbajitā nāma ~ā); Nett 8,.3; Vism 344,.3 (tathārūpaṃ ~aṃ bhikkhuṃ vā lajjiṃ manussaṃ vā disvā); Mp IV 71,.16 (~an ti gāravuppattipaccayabhūtaṃ garubhāvanīyaṃ); It-a I 159,.26 (garūnan ti mahāpitucullapitujeṭṭhabhātu-ādīnaṃ ~ānaṃ); Cp-a 311,.24 (kalyāṇamittānaṃ ~ānaṃ); —        °-tara,   mfn., heavier; more to be esteemed; D II 334,.25 (yadā pana so kālakato hoti tadā ~o ca hoti patthīnataro ca); Dhp-a I 381,.3 (~ānaṃ santike nisīditvā); Pv-a 191,.27 (sālipalāse … ~e katvā); —       °-dakkhiṇā,   f., a teacher’s fee; Vv-a 229,.24 (kin te ~aṃ demī ti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee guru-); Th-a III 55,.35 (niṭṭhitasippena nāma antevāsinā ācariyassa ~ā dātabbā); —       °-dhamma,   m. [garu + dhamma1], 1. an important or serious offence; a breach of a serious rule of observance; Vin I 49,.18 (sace upajjhāyo ~aṃ ajjhāpanno hoti parivāsāraho …); IV 51,.34 (na kho pan’ etaṃ bhagavantaṃ uddissa pabbajitāya kāsāyavatthavasanāya ~aṃ ajjhāpannapubbo hoti; Sp 790,.33 : ~an ti gihikāle bhikkhuniyā kāya-saṃsaggaṃ vā sikkhamānasāmaṇerīsu methuna-dhammaṃ vā anajjhāpannapubbo hoti) ≠ A IV 280,.5; A IV 277,.6 (~aṃ ajjhāpannāya bhikkhuniyā ubhato-saṅghe pakkhamānattaṃ caritabbaṃ; Mp IV 135,.12 : ~an ti garukaṃ saṅghādisesāpattiṃ); — see also garuka; — 2. an important or exacting rule of observance (perhaps an observance of respect?), one of the eight specific rules of behaviour imposed on bhikkhunī s; Vin II 255,.5 (sace … Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī aṭṭha ~e paṭigaṇhāti sā v’ assā hotu upasampadā, vassasatupasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadahusampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ … kātabbaṃ, ayaṃ pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā … yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo …); IV 315,.6 (ovādo nāma aṭṭha ~ā); Sp 791,.16 foll. (~ehī ti garukehi dhammehi, te hi gāravaṃ katvā bhikkhunīhi sampaṭicchitabbattā ~ā ti vuccanti); Dhp-a IV 149,.19 (mayā Mahāpajāpatiyā Gotamiyā aṭṭha ~ā dinnā); Vin-vn 2970; —       °-bhaṇḍa,   n., property or goods held in common by the saṅgha; Vin III 90,.12 (yāni tāni saṅghassa ~āni garuparikkhārāni seyyathīdaṃ ārāmo ārāmavatthu vihāro …); Sp 484,.14 (ettha pañcamāsakagghanakaṃ ~an ti vuccati); 678,.10 (senāsanassa ~-ttā); 1110,.2 (~aṃ na bhājetabbaṃ); 1244,.1 (imesu tāva yaṃ kiñci khuddakaṃ vā hotu mahantaṃ vā saṅghassa dinnaṃ ~aṃ hoti); Kkh2 233,.4 (rāsivasena hi pañca ~āni vuttāni); Nidd-a I 398,.5 (kataraṃ pana dāru ~aṃ hoti kataraṃ na hotī ti); Vibh-a 334,.1 foll.; Vin-vn 181; 2872 (rajjukā yottakāni vā … gacchanti ~-taṃ); — neg. agarubhaṇḍa, n., Kkh2 233,.17; —       °-bhaṇḍaka,   n., id.; Vin-vn 2858; — neg. agarubhaṇḍaka, n., Vin-vn 2857; —       °-bhāra1,   m., a heavy burden, a heavy load; Ja IV 233,27* (~aṃ asahamāno); Th-a II 277,.29 (atibhārena ~ena pīḷito, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee mahābhārena °-bhāvena); —       °-bhāra2,   mfn., carrying a heavy load; burdened; Ja III 322,.27 (assaṃ gahetvā gamanakāle ~-tāya olīnavegaṃ sīhaṃ); — ~ā, f., pregnant; Vin IV 317,.12 (~ā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-gabbhā); Ja VI 420,.16 (sā pana tadā ~ā ahosi tasmā sā vegena palāyituṃ nāsakkhi, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-gabbhā); Vism 144,.1 (tvaṃ ~ā akāle carituṃ na sakkosi); Spk III 220,.9 (~-ttā); —       °-vacana,   n., an expression of respect or esteem; Vin I 103,.14 (āyasmanto ti piyavacanaṃ etaṃ ~aṃ etaṃ sagārava-sappatissādhivacanaṃ etaṃ); Nidd I 140,.2; It-a I 5,.21 (bhagavā ti ~aṃ); —       °-vāsa,   m. [garu + vāsa3], residing with one’s teacher; pupilship; Ps I 58,.30 (idāni mayaṃ yāvajīvaṃ ~aṃ vasissāma, mahantā ete ācariyā nāma, Be so; Ce, Ee guruvāsaṃ; Se °-saṃvāsaṃ); Th-a II 157,.16 (~aṃ sappurisūpassayaṃ ca pasaṃsanto); Cp-a 268,.6 (disāpāmokkhassa ācariyassa santike ~aṃ vasanto); — sagaruvāsa, m., id.; Vibh-a 499,.26 (sagaruvāsaṃ avasanaṭṭhena agāravabhāvo); — neg. agaruvāsa, m., Th-a II 16,.23 (dukkho kho panāyaṃ loke yadidaṃ agaruvāso ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee loko); —       °-saṃvāsa,   m., residing with, associating with one’s teacher(s), pupilship; Nidd I 359,.27 (mohacaritaṃ bhagavā puggalaṃ uddese paripucchāya … ~e niveseti; Nidd-a I 385,.11 : ~e ti garūnaṃ payirupāsane); Mil 408,.5 (~e kalyāṇamittasevane, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se guru-saṃvāse); It-a I 165,.15; —      agaru,   mfn., 1. not burden-some; not difficult; Vin I 24,.20 (sace te Kassapa ~u vaseyyāma ekarattaṃ agyāgāre ti); D I 89,.26 (~u kho pana bhagavato evarūpehi kulaputtehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo hotī ti); M I 111,.26 (vibhajat’ āyasmā Mahākaccāno ~uṃ katvā ti, Be so; Ce agarukatvā; Ee, Se agarukaritvā; Ps II 76,.30 foll. : punappunaṃ yācāpento pi hi garuṃ karoti nāma … duviññeyyaṃ katvā kathento pi garuṃ karoti yeva nāma, evaṃ akatvā amhe punappunaṃ ayācāpetvā suviññeyyaṃ pi no katvā kathehī ti vuttaṃ hoti) ≠ S IV 95,.13 (eds ~uṃ karitvā) ≠ A V 257,.15 (Be, Ce ~uṃ karitvā; Ee agarukaritvā; Se agarukatvā); — 2. not esteemed; A III 110,.16 (bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca ~u ca abhāvanīyo); — 3. not esteeming; without respect; Th 953 (lahukā ~ū dhamme aññamaññaṃ agāravā; Th-a III 84,.35 : saddhamme gāravarahitā); — agarukulavāsika, mfn., not living in the house of a teacher; not being a pupil; Mil 288,.18 (~-kulavāsiko … puggalo [lokasmiṃ oñāto avañāto]); —      atigaru,   mfn., very esteemed; very venerated; Sp 208,.32 (~unā pabbajjūpagatena sāmiputtena saddhiṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee atigarunāmapabbajjūpagatena); Ps III 351,.14 (~uno sammāsambuddhassa); — see also garukaroti, guru.
gaṇayati:
gaṇeti, ~ayati
pr. 3 sg.
